title: 第25章 再度离别第26章 竹箫的秘密
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 陈沫回答，“那一行人虽然只有筑基期，但年轻，又嚣张跋扈，应是大宗门弟子，最好还是别扯上恩怨，麻烦。”
巫未央鼓了鼓脸，对他们印象很不好，本以为是好心，结果明明是想抢她东西。
是的，她反应过来了。
叫云澄的女子一直纠缠，先是打她付灵石的手，又是想从她手里拿枯枝，最后更是心狠手辣下杀手，根本不是什么好东西。
她将事情本末完完整整告诉陈沫，并将枯枝递给了他。
陈沫早已猜出大概，拿起枯枝仔细瞧了瞧，蓦然睁眼，“养魂木？”
虽然已经干枯，可是仔细一看还是能看清枯枝上黑蓝黑蓝的星星斑点，这就是养魂木枯萎后的特征。
“你的眼睛挺尖呀。”
陈沫不由地说道。
巫未央扬起小脸，“那必须的。”
灵植图鉴中也提到过养魂木枯萎后的样子，她方才远远一看还没那么确定，等走近了才确认。
幸好摊主不认识养魂木枯萎后的样子，不然轮不到巫未央捡漏。
枯萎后的养魂木基本没有原本浓厚的魂力气息，很多人都认不出来，不是所有人都能像巫未央这样过目不忘的，修仙界灵植万千，很多人识得大概已经是极限了。
巫未央：“掌门，你能把它养活治伤吗？”
陈沫点头，“需要费一些精力，你确定把它就这么给我？”
巫未央：“掌门教了我那么多，孝敬您是应该的。”
陈沫心里慰贴，若是他因果解决后，专心养巫未央也好。
“这两枚天灵果你回去后服下吧，能增进你的修为。”
陈沫最不放心的就是巫未央年纪小，修为低，“伤好之后我要去了结一些因果，恐不能继续在你左右，你修为高些也有自保之力。”
陈沫将两枚天灵果不容拒绝地扔到巫未央怀里。
巫未央抱着天灵果，重重点头。
今日，她再一次意识到了强大的重要性。
两人回了朝天宗山门，陈沫一心培育养魂木，偶尔抽空检查巫未央的炼器术，指点一二。
巫未央服下两颗天灵果之后，修为直接到了练气八层，而且这个过程迅速又不会产生杂气，对五灵根来说简直是大好处。
如果要巫未央自己修炼，再勤奋也得两三年才能突破。
只是天灵果难得，而且对后期修为精进也越来越少，不然要是能一直磕天灵果，不管什么灵根都能起飞。
巫未央只是幻想了一下那样的美好，现实中还是脚踏实地地一步步修炼。
巩固一番修为后，巫未央拿出阵法图。
阵法图中，低阶阵法有聚灵阵，防御阵，隐匿阵，隔音阵，困阵等等等等上千个阵，而五个中阶阵法，一个是龟息阵，这似乎是隐匿阵和隔音阵的升级版，一个是火系攻击阵，一个是水系攻击阵，还有一个是土系防御阵，以及一个迷幻阵。
真的很良心了，攻防兼备，还有出行必备多功能。
巫未央很满意，重新翻到第一页，入门的第一个阵法是聚灵阵，这是最简单的阵法。
content_en:
Chen Mo replied, "Although that group of people are only in the foundation building stage, they are young and arrogant. They should be disciples of a large sect. It is best not to get into trouble."
Wu Weiyang puffed up her face and had a bad impression of them. She thought they were kindhearted, but it turned out that they clearly wanted to steal her things.
Yes, she reacted.
The woman named Yuncheng kept pestering her, first hitting her hand that held the spirit stone, then trying to take the dead branch from her hand, and finally killing her cruelly, which was not a good thing at all.
She told Chen Mo the whole story and handed him the dead branch.
Chen Mo had already guessed it. He picked up the dead branch and looked at it carefully. He suddenly opened his eyes and said, "Soul-nurturing tree?"
Although it has dried up, if you look closely, you can still clearly see the black and blue star spots on the dead branches. This is the characteristic of the soul-nourishing tree after it has withered.
"Your eyes are quite sharp."
Chen Mo couldn't help but said.
Wu Weiyang raised her face and said, "That's necessary."
The Spiritual Plant Illustrated Book also mentioned the appearance of the soul-nurturing tree after it withered. She wasn't so sure when she saw it from a distance, and she didn't confirm it until she got closer.
Fortunately, the stall owner didn't know what the soul-nurturing wood looked like after it withered, otherwise it wouldn't have been Wu Weiyang's turn to pick it up.
The withered soul-nurturing wood basically has no original strong soul power aura, and many people cannot recognize it. Not everyone can have a photographic memory like Wu Weiyang. There are thousands of spiritual plants in the world of immortality, and many people have probably reached the limit of recognition.
Wu Weiyang: "Master, can you feed it and heal it?"
Chen Mo nodded, "It takes some effort. Are you sure you want to give it to me like this?"
Wu Weiyang: "The master has taught me so much, I should be filial to you."
Chen Mo felt comforted in his heart, it would be good if he could concentrate on raising Wu Weiyang after his cause and effect was resolved.
"You should take these two Heavenly Spirit Fruits after you go back. They will improve your cultivation."
What Chen Mo is most worried about is that Wu Weiyang is young and has low cultivation level. "After I recover from the injury, I am going to resolve some causes and consequences. I may not be able to continue to be around you. If you have a higher cultivation level, you will be able to protect yourself."
Chen Mo threw the two Heavenly Spirit Fruits into Wu Weiyang's arms without rejection.
Wu Weiyang held the Tianling Fruit and nodded heavily.
Today, she once again realized the importance of being strong.
The two returned to the Chaotian Sect's mountain gate. Chen Mo concentrated on cultivating the soul-nurturing wood, and occasionally took the time to check Wu Weiyang's weapon refining skills and give some pointers.
After Wu Weiyang took two Heavenly Spirit Fruits, his cultivation reached the eighth level of Qi training. Moreover, the process was quick and did not produce any stray energy, which was a great benefit to the Five Spiritual Roots.
If Wu Weiyang had to practice on his own, it would take two or three years to achieve a breakthrough no matter how hard he worked.
It's just that the Heavenly Spirit Fruit is rare, and there are fewer and fewer people who want to improve their later cultivation. Otherwise, if they can keep knocking on the Heavenly Spirit Fruit, no matter what spiritual root they have, they can take off.
Wu Weiyang just fantasized about such a beauty, but in reality he still practiced step by step in a down-to-earth manner.
After consolidating his cultivation, Wu Weiyang took out the formation diagram.
In the formation diagram, there are thousands of low-level formations including spirit-gathering formation, defense formation, concealment formation, sound-proof formation, trapping formation, etc., while there are five mid-level formations, one is the Turtle Breath Formation, which seems to be an upgraded version of the concealment formation and the sound-isolation formation, one is a fire-based attack formation, one is a water-based attack formation, one is an earth-based defensive formation, and a psychedelic formation.
It’s really conscientious, capable of both offense and defense, and has multiple functions that are essential for travel.
Wu Weiyang was very satisfied and turned to the first page again. The first formation to get started with was the Spirit Gathering Formation, which was the simplest formation.
